## Architecture Overview

The `Discoverer` interface is defined in `prometheus/discovery/discovery.go` with a single method `Run(ctx context.Context, up chan<- []*targetgroup.Group)`. There are 31+ provider implementations in prometheus/discovery/ (AWS, Azure, Consul, DNS, Kubernetes, etc.). Adding `HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error` requires every implementation to add this method.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definition

- **`discovery/discovery.go`** — Discoverer interface with Run() method. Also defines DiscovererMetrics, DiscovererOptions, Config interfaces.
- **`discovery/manager.go`** — Discovery manager orchestrating multiple discoverers.
- **`discovery/refresh/refresh.go`** — Refresh wrapper implementation.

### Key Provider Implementations (All Must Add HealthCheck)

- **`discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go`** — Kubernetes discovery with sub-discoverers (endpoints, endpointslice, ingress, node, pod, service).
- **`discovery/consul/consul.go`** — Consul discovery.
- **`discovery/dns/dns.go`** — DNS discovery.
- **`discovery/file/file.go`** — File discovery.
- **`discovery/http/http.go`** — HTTP discovery.
- **`discovery/aws/aws.go`** — AWS EC2/Lightsail discovery.
- **`discovery/azure/azure.go`** — Azure discovery.
- **`discovery/gce/gce.go`** — Google Compute Engine discovery.

### Thanos Integration

- **`thanos/pkg/discovery/cache/cache.go`** — Caching discovery wrapper.
- **`thanos/pkg/discovery/dns/`** — DNS discovery provider.
- **`thanos/cmd/thanos/endpointset.go`** — Uses prometheus discovery.

### Loki/Promtail Integration

- **`loki/clients/pkg/promtail/discovery/consulagent/consul.go`** — Consul discovery for Promtail.

### Test Mocks

- **`discovery/manager_test.go`** — `mockdiscoveryProvider`, `testDiscoverer`, `onceProvider` test implementations.

## Relevant Files

|------|-----------|-----|
| prometheus | discovery/discovery.go | Discoverer interface definition |
| prometheus | discovery/manager.go | Discovery manager orchestrating discoverers |
| prometheus | discovery/refresh/refresh.go | Refresh wrapper implementation |
| prometheus | discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go | Kubernetes discovery with sub-discoverers |
| prometheus | discovery/consul/consul.go | Consul discovery implementation |
| prometheus | discovery/dns/dns.go | DNS discovery implementation |
| prometheus | discovery/file/file.go | File discovery implementation |
| prometheus | discovery/http/http.go | HTTP discovery implementation |
| prometheus | discovery/aws/aws.go | AWS discovery implementation |
| prometheus | discovery/azure/azure.go | Azure discovery implementation |
| prometheus | discovery/manager_test.go | Test mocks (mockdiscoveryProvider, testDiscoverer) |
| thanos | pkg/discovery/cache/cache.go | Caching discovery wrapper |
| thanos | cmd/thanos/endpointset.go | Uses prometheus discovery |
| loki | clients/pkg/promtail/discovery/consulagent/consul.go | Consul discovery for Promtail |
